title: What Was Ever Mine?
seoTitle: What Was Ever Mine? | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal reflection on ownership, emotional entitlement, love, generosity and why caring for someone does not mean possessing them.
deck: On the things we claim as ours, the people we cannot possess, and the responsibilities we carry when we love or give.
heroAlt: Original editorial cover for What Was Ever Mine?, a philosophical reflection on ownership, generosity and human freedom.
heroCaption: Love is not a claim of possession; care does not create ownership.

sources.name: Qur'an — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:262–263

sources.name: Qur'an — Surah Al-Insan 76:8–9

sources.name: Qur'an — Surah Ar-Rum 30:21

sources.name: Qur'an — Surah Al-Isra 17:70
